name: storyline-code-style
description: A code style for Claude Code where every file reads top to bottom like a story: file headers, chapter and section banners, flat main paths, named transformation steps, documented parameters and logs as a narrative trail.

plugins.name: storyline-code-style
plugins.description: Code style skill for PowerShell, Terraform, Bicep, YAML pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps), Docker Compose, Kubernetes / Helm, JavaScript / Node.js and C++. General rules plus one reference file per language, loaded only when needed.
